chunks: God will not call you to account for that which is senseless in your oaths, but only for what is in your hearts; for God is forgiving and forbearing.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between lughw oaths and intentional oaths in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for distinguishing between casual speech (lughw) and deliberate intent, establishing that divine judgment focuses on the heart's conviction rather than mere verbal utterance. It underscores the principle of ease in religious obligations, noting that God holds believers accountable for what their hearts have truly earned, reflecting His attribute of being Forgiving and Forbearing.
